subject: TOURN: joinCode enforces nothing - anyone incl anonymous can join any tournament
description:
HIGH. ctfJoinTeam never reads a joinCode (the parameter does not exist); tournament-lobby.html has no code prompt; the only use of joinCode anywhere is as a salt ingredient at console.html:11108. firestore.rules:1225 is 'allow read: if true' so an UNAUTHENTICATED client can list every tournament and read the plaintext joinCode. Proven by Mallory in the emulator: an invite-only tournament discovered with no prior link, code read with zero auth. Only real participation control is request.auth != null, which anonymous sign-in satisfies. Roster slots could be filled by disposable accounts before a class arrives. Fix: require+verify joinCode in ctfJoinTeam and stop storing it in a world-readable doc.
[2026-09-08 01:52] STALE STATUS - the code says this is FIXED, found while scoping 364 (2026-09-08). ctfJoinTeam now accepts a joinCode param, reads the expected code from tournaments/{id}/private/config (admin-only per firestore.rules), verifies case-insensitively and throws permission-denied on mismatch. It FAILS CLOSED on a config read error rather than degrading to open ('do not turn an outage into an auth bypass'), and REFUSES when tournament.hasJoinCode===true but no code can be found (the two-round-trip creation race). Residual, deliberate not defective: a tournament with no code at all is genuinely open to any signed-in user, and one with no private config falls back to the world-readable public joinCode with a console warning. NOT closing this myself - I did not do the fix and cannot confirm it matches the full intent. Operator/whoever shipped it should verify and close.
